title: Damaged, Missing and Wrong Items on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
Damaged, missing and wrong items on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders are Tailwise's responsibility once the order is completed.

## Rule

- A damage or missing-item claim is accepted only if it is reported no later than the method's damage report days or missing-item report days after the order's completed date. The window is counted in calendar days from the completed date, that date being day 0; a report on the last day is in time.
- A wrong item is handled as a return with reason wrong item.
- For a damaged or missing line the customer chooses a free replacement, where the method allows replacement, or a refund.
- A refund up to the method's largest returnless refund is credited without the item coming back, while a larger one needs a return authorization.
- The units already refunded or credited on the line, plus the units claimed, do not exceed the line's quantity.

The completed date is read from the order's own record in the system for the order the claim concerns.

## Questions and answers

**From which date is the report period counted?** From the order's completed date, which is day 0, in calendar days.

**Is a report on the last day of the period accepted?** Yes. With a hypothetical 2-day period, a report on day 2 is in time and a report on day 3 is not.

**Is a wrong item settled as a damage claim?** No. A wrong item is handled as a return with reason wrong item.

**Who chooses between a replacement and a refund?** The customer, for a damaged or missing line; a replacement is possible only where the method allows it.

**When does the item have to come back?** When the refund is larger than the method's largest returnless refund; a refund up to that amount is credited without the item coming back.

**How many units can be credited on a line?** The units already refunded or credited on the line, plus the units now credited, may not exceed the line's quantity. On a hypothetical 3-unit line with 2 units already refunded, at most 1 more unit can be credited.
